title: 7 Claude Code power moves
blurb: Token-saving and autonomy tricks most people miss — from slimming the system prompt to orchestrating sandboxed worker agents.
body:
• Slim the system prompt — Claude Code loads ~18K tokens before you type (9% of context). Patching the CLI bundle cuts it to ~10K — ~7,300 tokens back for real work.
  • Talk to it with your voice — transcription is 3–4× faster than typing; use SuperWhisper or MacWhisper.
  • Use Gemini CLI as a fallback — for Reddit, paywalled sites or blocked URLs, route those requests through Gemini CLI via tmux.
  • Run inside containers — for risky long jobs, spin up Docker with --dangerously-skip-permissions; if it breaks, it's contained.
  • Orchestrate a worker Claude — local Claude starts a tmux session → runs a container → sends prompts via send-keys → reads output via capture-pane. A sandboxed autonomous worker.
  • Lazy-load MCP tools — set ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=true in settings.json so tools load on demand. Big token savings.
  • Manual exponential backoff — waiting on builds/CI? Have Claude check status at 1, 2, 4, 8 min intervals — more token-efficient than watching.
SOURCE · Claude Code power-user thread.
